card.text: Two-toned moon of Saturn, dark as coal on one side and bright on the other.

introduction.text: A ridge of mountains up to 10 km high circles Iapetus's equator. Giovanni Cassini noticed its dark side in 1671.

normal.title: Multi-mission image mosaic
normal.summary: Polar detail is coarser than elsewhere; shadows and seams in the photographs remain.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color composite
enhanced.summary: Colors extend into infrared and ultraviolet. The dark hemisphere is real surface material, not missing data.

infrared.title: Cassini VIMS flyby spectra
infrared.summary: False color from 2.02, 1.59 and 1.28 µm over part of the surface, with lighting still in the values.

ice-absorption.title: VIMS flyby water-ice absorption
ice-absorption.summary: Water-ice absorption near 2.02 µm where Cassini observed; it does not measure ice abundance.
